Name: New NPC Thurstan 1.6
Author: muxuelaiyin
Description:
你好，这里是瑟斯坦的非官方1.6更新，已经取得原作者授权。

瑟斯坦自称是无意间来到星露谷的旅者，他在与你初遇后，便会每天乘坐巴士来到鹈鹕镇。他的身世不明，似乎很忌讳谈及自己的过去，但在好感慢慢增加后，他便会对你袒露心声......
去成为他唯一的“挚友”吧，他等待着你。

如何解锁瑟斯坦：

0：游戏时间4天后，必需在春天，13：00-17：00前往山区。

好感事件：
2：必需在星期一、星期二，晴天，17：00-20：00前往森林。
4：除了星期天，雨天，15：00-18：30前往森林。
6：必需在星期二、星期四、星期六，晴天，8：00-14：00前往海滩。
8-1：必需在星期天，晴天，6：00-12：00前往森林。（结束后瑟斯坦将暂时离开星露谷。）
8-2：必需在星期天，看过8-1，晴天，16：00-18：00前往巴士站。

喜好：
最爱：火水晶、红莓酱、蜜蜂酒、蓝晶石、意式烤面包、生命药水
喜欢：加工品、花卉、料理类、黑莓
不喜欢：鲶鱼、惊喜鲤鱼、工作小食、兔子的脚
讨厌：爆炒青椒、红蘑菇、清汤

PS：
1.一共三版高清肖像，选择喜欢的一版去掉名字后的数字，放进999MOD即可。（肖像和CG的素材都由原作者提供，请赞美她！）
2.瑟斯坦的日常对话文本量非常多，以随机形式出现，如果想体验完整剧情，建议慢一点升好感。
3.该MOD未来还会更新内容，有任何建议可以告诉我。
4.有任何问题请在此处留言或者在XHS找我，我看到有空就会修，但是请描述得详细一点，因为我比较菜。
5.现在应该与所有MOD兼容，如果你发现有冲突，请告诉我，我很乐意为它制作补丁。
6.如果你喜欢这个mod，请在下载完成后回到主界面给我点个赞，拜托拜托。
_________________________________________________________________________________
(Sorry, my English is not good, so I used software translation.)

Hello, this is the unofficial 1.6 update from Thurstan, which has been authorized by the original author.
﻿
Thurstan claimed to be a traveler who accidentally came to Stardew Valley. After meeting you for the first time, he would take a bus to Pelican Town every day. His background is unknown, and he seems to be reluctant to talk about his past, but as his affection gradually increases, he will reveal his feelings to you
Go and become his only 'close friend', he is waiting for you.
﻿
How to unlock Thurstan:
﻿
0: After 4 days of game time, it is necessary to go to the mountainous area in spring from 13:00 to 17:00.

Hearts event:
﻿
2: On Monday or Tuesday, sunny days, head to the forest from 17:00-20:00.
4: Not on Sunday, it's raining, go to the forest from 15:00-18:30.
6: On Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, sunny days, go to the beach from 8:00-14:00.
8-1: On Sunday, sunny days, go to the forest from 6:00 to 12:00. (After the end, Thurstan will temporarily leave Stardew Valley.)
8-2: On Sunday, after watching 8-1,sunny days,go to the bus stop from 16:00-18:00.

Gift Tastes:
Love: fire crystal, cranberry sauce, bee wine, kyanite, Italian toast, life Potion
Likes: processed products, flowers, cuisine, blackberry
Dislike: catfish, surprise carp, work snacks, rabbit feet
Hate: stir fried green pepper, red mushroom, clear soup

附言：
1. There are three high-definition portraits in total. Choose the one you like, remove the number after the name, and put it in 999MOD.(The portrait and CG materials were provided by the original author, please praise her!)
2. Thurstan's daily conversations have a large amount of text, appearing in random form. If you want to experience the complete plot, it is recommended to slow down.
3. The MOD will be updated in the future, please let me know if you have any suggestions.
4. If you have any questions, please leave a message here or contact me on XHS. I will fix them when I have time, but please describe them in more detail
because I am a bit inexperienced.
5. It should be compatible with all mods now. If you find any conflicts, please let me know and I will be happy to make patches for it.
6. If you like this mod, please give me a like on the main interface after downloading it, please.

！！ Anyone who wants to translate this mod into other languages is welcome, and I would be extremely grateful.！！
